node: Private-label co-manufacturing, specialty packaging, and value-tier consumer staples inputs
summary: Layer 1B expanded the node toward US-listed companies tied to private-label/value-tier consumer staples through scarce production capacity, retailer qualification, packaging formats, food-safety or ingredient know-how, and retailer service-level requirements. The cleanest former public pure-play, TreeHouse Foods, is now excluded from the candidate list because it completed a take-private transaction and was delisted on February 11, 2026. Remaining public-market exposure is less pure but still researchable through canned/frozen private-label capacity, cat-litter and absorbent-material private-label supply, rigid consumer packaging, and food ingredient systems used by value-tier/private-label manufacturers.
